summary: Frontend-only regression for SMARTCLOUT iteration 6: divider dither/blend split by contrast, PartnersV2 col-span 5/7 layout with 8-slot 2x4 scatter (no overlap, longer per-slot 3.5-6s cycles), About narrative as 3-paragraph array in PL and EN. ALL 17 acceptance items PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: PartnersV2Section.jsx: makeSlot() uses tickRef.current inside key generation but the key still uses `${tickRef.current}-${slotIndex}-...` which regenerates React nodes on every cycle. This is intentional to force fade-in restart, but a cleaner solution would be to use CSS animation-iteration-count with a stable key + animation-name change. Minor.
AboutSection.jsx line 1 still imports useState (used for pillar toggle only). PILLARS default active pillar is hardcoded (PILLARS[1].id 'holistic') — brittle if PILLARS order changes. Minor.

SectionDivider.jsx: contrast threshold 100 is inclusive lower bound. hero-about (dark #040709 vs white) contrast=~254, sectors-rack=~254, rack-partners=~248, partners-contact=~248 all well above 100. light-light contrast<20 all correctly rendered as blend. Threshold value 100 is safe.
translations.js: narrative is now an array in both PL and EN. Legacy consumers should be aware — AboutSection defensively handles both string and array via Array.isArray fallback, which is good.
App.css is still 3594 lines; splitting recommended for maintainability.
